sources.title: EAC visa-free entry
sources.officialityEvidence: The EAC is the regional intergovernmental body publishing this Partner-State entry guidance. Its endpoint returned HTTP 403 in this review environment on 2026-08-24; the live indexed text states the Article 7(1) implementation claim.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Partner States are implementing Article 7(1) of the EAC Common Market Protocol

sources.title: East African Community FAQ: legacy DRC exception
sources.officialityEvidence: The EAC's official FAQ retains a direct DRC exception, but is labelled as written in 2016. Its endpoint returned HTTP 403 in this review environment on 2026-08-24, so it is retained only as a conflict, not as a current rule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of East African Community Partner States (with the exception of DRC) do not require visas

conflicts.explanation: The EAC's current migration page says all Partner States implement visa-free entry for citizens into other Partner-State territories, while its still-live 2016 FAQ expressly excludes DRC both as origin and destination. The DRC MFA has no Kenyan nationality decision to resolve the conflict.

unresolved.reason: The current DRC MFA service describes consular filing but supplies no Mauritius ordinary-passport result or issuance timing. No arrival route is inferred from older or non-DRC material.

The EAC's current migration page states a Partner-State visa-free rule that directly covers Kenyan citizens entering another Partner State, but its still-live 2016 FAQ expressly excludes DRC as origin and destination. DRC MFA consular wording does not resolve this contradiction, so no baseline is normalized.

The EAC's current migration page states a Partner-State visa-free rule that directly covers Tanzanian citizens entering another Partner State, but its still-live 2016 FAQ expressly excludes DRC as origin and destination. DRC MFA consular wording does not resolve this contradiction, so no baseline is normalized.
